title: Mobility Zaragoza — Bizi ETL Pipeline
description: Python ETL pipeline that ingests real-time public bike station data from Zaragoza's Open Data API, transforms it with Pandas and loads it into PostgreSQL using an idempotent upsert strategy.

title: Spanish Electricity Market — End-to-end dbt Pipeline
description: Analytics engineering pipeline on the Spanish electricity market (ESIOS/REE API), with dbt Core as the centerpiece. Python extraction with an idempotent MERGE pattern, GitHub Actions orchestration with dual scheduling (cron-job.org + native fallback), three-layer dbt transformation (staging, intermediate, marts) with 17 automated tests, and an interactive Evidence.dev dashboard visualizing the merit order effect: the correlation between renewable generation and electricity price. dbt docs and lineage: https://e-saldanaf.github.io/esios-energy-pipeline/
